hints.title: Josephus Recurrence Relation
hints.text: This is the classical Josephus problem where each elimination shifts remaining indices by k.

hints.title: Bottom Up Index Shift
hints.text: The winner index in a circle of size i can be derived from size i - 1 via (f(i - 1) + k) % i.

hints.title: One Based Adjustment
hints.text: Start with 0-based index 0 for circle of size 1, build up to n, and add 1 to the final result.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating circle eliminations with list removals takes O(n^2) time due to element shifting.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Josephus mathematical recurrence computes the winner iteratively in O(n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies the Josephus transition formula f(i) = (f(i-1) + k) % i.
